costs.label: Costs and donations
costs.use: Planned and actual costs, the amount per person and the sum of donations.
costs.countMissing: Enter the number of participants to see the amount per person.
costs.noItems: The cost items have not been filled in yet.
costs.showsBlock: Sums, a table of items (per person, if the number of participants is given) and donations.
costs.currencyHint: For example PLN, EUR or USD.
costs.participantsHint: Costs per person are calculated from this.

ex.note: The amounts are updated by the organiser.

k.participantCount: Number of participants to split the costs (or null)

masses.label: Masses and services
masses.use: The order of masses from a calendar, with intentions.
masses.daysHint: Empty: as many as fit in the tile

form.label: Form
form.use: Questions and submissions; everyone gets their own address.
form.showsStrip: Heading and button — the form opens on click.
form.exSmsText: Departure tomorrow at 7:00 from the church.
form.exSentText:
Meeting on Saturday at 7:00 in front of the church.

Bring your school ID.
form.exSigner: legible signature of a parent / legal guardian
form.sPortalUnder: Under which page the person’s portal is created after submitting — a path, e.g. "parafia/pielgrzymka" (must be this page or lie under it)
form.sSms: Message templates for those who signed up — a list
form.sSentText: Text after sending — "\n" new line, an empty line a new paragraph
form.sPaper: Handwritten signature on the printout: "always", "sign" (when the form shows a statement to sign — a text with "sign": true in the layout, e.g. a parent’s consent that the logic shows only to minors without a parent; this sets the requirement "minor"), "minor" (a minor — by date of birth or PESEL on the day of filling in) or the id of a “Consent / statement” or “Yes / no” question — then when it is ticked
form.sSigner: Who signs — the caption under the signature line on the printout
form.sPortalAt: Addition to the page address after sending (portalUnder): "#slide-name" (opens that slide), "?s=3" (the third slide), "?part=<module id>" or together "?s=2#zapisy"; starts with "?" or "#", no spaces; the link adds the person’s key itself

slots.label: Booking
slots.use: An appointment with the priest, a room, a house — someone takes something for a time.
slots.showsStrip: Heading and button — the times open on click.

entryList.label: List of people
entryList.use: Everyone from a form — search, step filter; the name opens that person’s page (with the panel). For coordinators.
entryList.noForm: A list of people will appear here — a form still has to be chosen.
entryList.pickPage: · choose in the “Person’s page” module to open a person on their page
entryList.empty: There is nobody in this form yet.
entryList.pageHint: e.g. the candidate’s page (the one from their link) — opened from the list it shows the chosen person
entryList.missingPage: Choose the person’s page — without it names lead nowhere.
entryList.showsWide: Search and filter, then a table: person, phone, chosen answers, progress.
entryList.showsBlock: Search and filter, then just the names with progress.

entryPanel.label: Person panel
entryPanel.use: Everything about the person chosen at the top of the page: answers, steps, extensions, link, conversation. Requires “Choice on the page”: a person from a form.
entryPanel.noSubject: This page does not choose a person — in the page settings set “Choice on the page”: a person from a form.
entryPanel.later: The person will appear here once chosen at the top of the page.
entryPanel.empty: There is nobody in the form yet.
entryPanel.hint: The person is chosen at the top of the page — in the page settings “Choice on the page”: a person from a form. Several panels on one page show the same person: e.g. answers in one, steps in another.
entryPanel.sTitle: heading; empty — the name of the chosen person
entryPanel.showsStrip: Name of the chosen person, phone and progress.

plan.label: Plan
plan.use: A programme grouped into stages (days), with times.
plan.showsStrip: A button that opens the programme.
plan.showsBlock: The first stage expanded, the others to expand.
plan.caption: Caption

k.rows: Programme items in this stage — a list
k.title: What happens

people.label: People
people.use: Cards of people with their role, photo and contact.
people.showsStrip: Photos with names in one row.
people.showsNarrow: A list of people with role and contact.
people.showsBlock: Cards of people: photo, role, description, contact.
people.name: First and last name
people.contactHint: Phone or e-mail — the link is created by itself.
people.contactHrefHint: Only if it should lead elsewhere, e.g. https://…

ex.name: John Smith
ex.detail: Leads the group and keeps the pace.

k.name: First and last name
k.photo: Photo: an https://… address or a page file "page-image:<id>" (or null)
k.contact: Contact — phone or e-mail; it turns into a link by itself (or null)
k.contactHref: Own contact link, e.g. "https://…" (or null — from the contact field)

program.label: Event programme
program.use: An appointment from the calendar together with its items (and sub-items) — a retreat, a pilgrimage, a fair. Changes in the calendar show on the page right away.
program.title: Programme
program.none: The programme cannot be shown — the appointment is hidden or does not exist.
program.notReady: The programme is not ready yet.
program.bitWhole: Name, date and place of the whole appointment
program.bitLink: Button with the link of the whole appointment
program.bitPointLinks: Buttons with links at the items
program.hide: What it shows (besides the items with times)
program.missingCalendar: Choose a calendar, then an appointment — its programme will appear on the page.
program.missingItem: Choose the appointment whose programme should be shown.
program.showsStrip: Name and number of items in one line.
program.showsStripDate: Name, date and number of items in one line.
program.showsTall: The whole programme: all levels with place and notes.
program.showsBlock: First-level items with times; sub-items as a number.

calendar.label: Calendar
calendar.use: Appointments of the chosen calendars on the page — in full screen the people who run them can also add and change appointments.
calendar.missing: Tick at least one calendar — without it the tile will not appear on the page.
calendar.showsStrip: The next appointment in one line.
calendar.showsWideTall: A week in an hour grid with scrolling days; plus week, month and list.
calendar.showsTall: The next appointments (up to 12) and how they work.

chat.label: Conversation
chat.use: The conversation of a chosen group on the page — whoever belongs to the group or has their link reads and writes in it.
chat.missing: Choose a conversation — without it the tile will not appear on the page.
chat.showsTall: Conversation with a longer view of messages and a field to write.
